lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A grid-like arrangement of high-luminance circular pixel clusters is visible posterior to the gill slits. These nodes are organized into roughly parallel vertical columns and horizontal rows, creating a structured 2D array across the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Pale vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect the horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs, forming a distinct checkerboard-like grid of anchor nodes on the lateral surface.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Multiple horizontal linear features are visible on the upper flank, characterized by a sharp vertical gradient in pixel intensity with highlight on the dorsal edge and shadow on the ventral edge, indicating longitudinal ridges.

other_distinctive_markers: The cephalic region exhibits a high density of significantly smaller, less ordered high-luminance clusters compared to the lateral flank. The leading edge of the pectoral fin (partially visible) also displays a distinct pattern of small white nodes.
